title: Creating a Discord webhook named after the product fails because the name contains discord
symptoms: DiscordAPIError[50035]: Invalid Form Body on create webhook
Webhook named Discord Alerts or Clyde Bot is rejected
Same request works with a different name
cause: Webhook names may not contain the substrings discord or clyde in any letter case. The rule is listed under Create Webhook, not under the username override on Execute Webhook.
fix: Pick a name without those substrings and validate user-supplied names before calling the API.
affected: Discord API v10 Create Webhook, as of 2026-10
